description.narrative: Following the Energize Nepal project that ends in 2025, the Embasssy decided to seek ideas on how the projected increase in electricity generation can increase the economic development in Nepal, thereby reduce imports and subsidies and at the same time increase capacity, employment opportunities and local production. Together with two other selected projects this one was selected to implement such ideas. In particular this project aims to address the necessary regulatory regulatory framework needed to increase domestic consumptionof renewable enery in different sectors in Nepal. practical use of energy in different activities that promotes increased energy consumption and at the same time contruibute to decarbonisation in various value chains in the economy. This is planned to be done in a consortium consisting of Centre for Rural technology, Nepal Electricity Authority, Chamber of Nepalese Industry, Ambidience Global and Centre for Energy Studies, Tribuvan University.
